name: Pokedex Sprites (HGSS)
description: Replaces the Pokedex ENTRY PAGE art (highlight a caught Pokemon, choose DATA) with HeartGold/SoulSilver-style sprites for all 151 species, and repaints the dex list caught marker as a red-and-white Poke Ball. Battle, party summary, evolution, Hall of Fame and every other sprite site keep vanilla art. NOTE: on engine v0.2.13+ set COLORS to ADVANCED -- the engine now honours full-colour art only in that mode. Options: CAUGHT BALL (MODERN/VANILLA) and DEX COLOR (BANDS/EXACT/BOX/OFF). Fan-art sprite swap sourced from Bulbagarden Archives; personal use.
